title: Consultant / Sr. Consultant - Energy Transition & Sustainability Strategy
description:
**About Pravi**

Pravi is a strategy and policy consulting firm that helps governments, institutions and businesses move from intent to implementation. Our work spans strategy, policy design, digital transformation and data-led decision-making, with a focus on outcomes that can be measured on the ground.

**Why this Role**

India is in the middle of one of the largest energy transitions in the world. Decisions being taken now on storage, renewables, energy efficiency, clean fuels and carbon markets will shape how the country produces and uses energy for decades. You will help shape policies, programmes and implement them in renewable energy, energy storage, energy efficiency, carbon markets and clean fuels. You will assist in research of what works, support decisions, set up the systems that put those decisions into action, and work directly with senior officials and industry leaders.

**Key focus areas**

* Energy efficiency and conservation: BEE programmes and their implementation, including PAT, CCTS, ECBC, Standards and Labelling, and Demand Side Management
* Renewable and alternative energy: Solar, wind and hybrid systems, grid integration and power system fundamentals, renewable purchase and consumption obligations (RPO/RCO)
* Energy storage: Battery Energy Storage Systems (BESS) and other storage technologies ○ Carbon markets and decarbonisation: carbon credit mechanisms, MRV, climate mitigation interventions and decarbonisation pathways
* Biogas and alternative fuels: Compressed Biogas (CBG), associated technologies and other clean fuels
* Waste and circular economy: waste management, and recycling and circular management of renewable energy equipment
* Climate change and emerging areas: sectoral implications of climate change, clean technologies and other emerging areas in the energy transition

**Key Responsibilities**

1. Research and Policy Assistance

* Undertake research and analysis across the focus areas to support decision-making
* Review existing policies and programmes to identify gaps requiring policy, regulatory or implementation interventions
* Draft issue notes, analytical briefs, policy documents, technical studies, background material and presentations
* Examine documents and matters requiring technical inputs, and prepare technical notes, comments and responses

2. Programme Design, Implementation and Management

* Translate climate and energy priorities into actionable plans, and support them through preparation, review and implementation
* Support the roll-out of policies, programmes and facilitation services, from design to day-to-day operations
* Support the setup, staffing and operation of dedicated cells of work areas, including RPO/RCO mechanisms and carbon credit facilitation
* Support the implementation of BEE schemes and initiatives under the Energy Conservation Act, 2001
* Assist in Demand Side Management programmes, management of energy conservation funds, PAT/CCTS processes and monitoring of renewable consumption obligations
* Monitor programme progress, consolidate information, and follow up on activities and action points
* Prepare periodic reports and submissions in prescribed formats and timelines
* Help conceptualise, develop, integrate and manage digital portals and platforms

3. Stakeholder Engagement and Coordination

* Coordinate with government departments, central ministries and agencies, industry associations, developers, manufacturers, financial institutions, international organisations, universities, research bodies and knowledge partners
* Manage meetings and consultations end to end: agendas, presentations, invitations, background material and data collection formats
* Record discussions, prepare Minutes of Meeting and track follow-up actions

4. Capacity Building and Knowledge Management

* Develop learning resources such as reference materials, knowledge toolkits, training content and print material, tailored to the stakeholder needs
* Plan and conduct training programmes, workshops and other learning sessions for stakeholders

**Required experience and skills**

● 4 to 10 years of experience in energy, power, climate, renewable, policy research, CSR or consulting sector

● Working knowledge of at least two of the focus areas listed above

● Understanding of power systems and renewable energy fundamentals

● Familiarity with BEE norms and energy efficiency programmes

● Strong research, analytical and report-writing skills

● Good presentation skills and proficiency in Excel and PowerPoint / Canva

● Experience engaging with senior stakeholders in government, industry or institutions

**Good to have**

● Experience with consulting firms, development organisations, think tanks, research institutions, or energy and sustainability companies

● BEE Certified Energy Auditor or Energy Manager certification

● Exposure to carbon markets, CBG or BESS projects

● Experience designing or managing CSR programmes

● Proficiency in Gujarati Language

**Who we are looking for**

You will do well in this role if you:

● Enjoy building a deep understanding of a subject and can explain it simply to others

● Structure your thinking before you write or speak, and communicate it clearly

● Question assumptions, including your own, and form views backed by evidence

● Are comfortable presenting to senior stakeholders and standing by your recommendations

● Take full ownership of your work, from the first draft to final delivery

● Are eager to learn new domains and stay confident when the path is not clearly defined

What can you expect from this role?

● Work on live energy transition projects with real implementation outcomes

● Direct exposure to senior decision-makers from early in your career

● Ownership of deliverables, not just support tasks

● Learning across multiple domains in a single versatile role

● A team where good work is always noticed and rewarded

title: Client Outreach Executive
description:
**Company Description**
RSE (Red Smile Entertainments) is a white-label post-production house specializing in wedding and corporate video editing for studios worldwide. Founded in 2018, the company has grown from a single editor to a dedicated team of 10 professionals serving clients across the UK, US, Canada, Australia, and the UAE. RSE works under strict NDAs, delivering all files under each client’s branding so that end viewers never know a third party was involved. The team manages wedding films, highlight reels, event coverage, and corporate videos, helping studios stay focused on production while RSE clears their editing backlog. RSE also offers free 30–60 second trial edits, giving potential partners a risk-free way to experience the service.

The role involves maintaining accurate records of interactions, following up on leads, gathering feedback from clients, and supporting long-term relationship building. Collaboration with the operations and editing teams will be essential to align client expectations with delivery timelines and service quality.

* Strong Communication and Customer Satisfaction skills to build trust, clarify requirements, and deliver a positive client experience.

* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Communications, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

title: Field Executive
description:
**Company Description**
ReAgri, a brand of NanoBee BioInnovations Pvt. Ltd., is a residue-free farming focused platform offering agri-inputs, agronomy services, and agri produce buyback through both online and offline channels. The company was founded to address the harmful impact of indiscriminate chemical pesticide and fungicide use on soil, the environment, and pest resistance. ReAgri provides farmers with guidance and solutions that enable residue-free farming and promote sustainable agricultural practices. Its products are designed to effectively manage soil issues, pests, and diseases while replacing synthetic and harmful chemical-based products. Leveraging extensive experience in residue-free farming methods, ReAgri is positioned to deliver an exclusive range of products and services tailored to the needs of the farming community.

The Field Executive will interact directly with farmers and local partners to promote ReAgri’s residue-free farming products and services, conduct product demonstrations, and support adoption of sustainable agronomy practices. Responsibilities include visiting farms and local markets, explaining product benefits, collecting customer feedback, and ensuring timely follow-up on inquiries and orders. The role also involves coordinating small meetings or field days, maintaining accurate records of field activities, and reporting market trends and farmer needs to the central team. The Field Executive will collaborate with sales and agronomy teams to achieve growth targets while building long-term relationships with the farming community.
  
**Qualifications**

* Strong communication and interpersonal skills to engage with farmers, local dealers, and internal teams.
* Basic knowledge of agriculture, crop production, and sustainable or residue-free farming practices.
* Ability to conduct field visits, product demonstrations, and small group meetings in rural and semi-urban areas.
* Organizational and record-keeping skills for maintaining visit logs, customer data, and activity reports.
* Comfort with using smartphones or tablets for data entry, messaging apps, and basic digital tools.
* Proactive problem-solving attitude and willingness to travel extensively within the assigned territory.

* Minimum educational qualification: Diploma or Bachelor’s degree in Agriculture or a related field preferred; candidates with strong relevant experience will also be considered.
* Ability to communicate in local languages of the Prantij region, along with basic English or Hindi, is beneficial.
